title: Reception (2nd type) — gaps -> answers, Romans 8:28-30 (WIDENED: all 18 open gaps)
engine: RECEPTION (#4) — gap-centric twin of the who-received view
widening_note: The prototype noded only 6 of the 18 open gaps (3 with grounded panel comments + 3 inferred-only). This widened set nodes ALL 18 open residual gaps and, for the ~15 previously un-glossed, runs the Christian-theology crit-panel in REASONING MODE to recommend, per gap, WHICH theologian's primary text most directly ANSWERS that specific silence and HOW (resolves / reframes / deepens / refuses-to-close). Every NEW edge is tagged inferred: the panel is RECOMMENDING who would answer, from documented positions — NOT a grounded DB gloss. The 18 grounded edges from the prototype are carried unchanged; grounded count is unchanged, inferred count grows.
anti_fabrication: Every theologian->gap edge is tagged grounded or inferred. GROUNDED = the S156 Gloss run (commentary_constellation_result, run_tag cc20_rom8_s156) directly records this persona commenting on this gap; the edge 'fill' is trimmed from that DB payload. INFERRED = the theologian did NOT comment on this gap in the run; the edge is a panel RECOMMENDATION of how their documented position would answer it. Inferred edges are plausible candidates for real sourcing, NOT asserted as fact. All 42 newly-added edges (S156 widening) are inferred.

grounding_key.gloss-seated: This persona was seated on the S156 crit-panel (cc20_rom8_grounding_s156) AND filed a comment on this exact gap. Edge is grounded; fill is the real DB gloss text.
grounding_key.attested: Well-attested historical reader of Romans 8 (from the who-received graph or the Christian reading bank SRC-2509xx) whose answer to this gap is reconstructed from the documentary record. Edge is inferred.
grounding_key.gap-scan: The gap itself is a real row in source_move_gap for ROM-8-28-30 (the move-grammar gap scan).

answer_types.resolves: Supplies a determinate answer that CLOSES the gap on the theologian's own terms.
answer_types.reframes: Recasts the question so the gap changes shape or dissolves into a different reading (often the rival camp's move).
answer_types.deepens: Supplies interior / experiential texture that ENRICHES the gap without settling the doctrinal question — the native response to an 'interior' gap.
answer_types.refuses-to-close: Deliberately preserves the gap AS gap (aporia-preserving). In this widened set, applied where the whole tradition answers but no camp CLOSES — the substrate 'those' gap is the keystone case.

gap_scan_summary.note: 31 gaps found on ROM-8-28-30 by the move-grammar scan. 13 filled-internally (closed by a move IN the text — no external answer needed). 18 open/residual — ALL 18 are now noded. 3 carry grounded panel answers (the cc20_rom8_s156 chair selected + 6 personas commented). 14 carry inferred panel-recommendations only. 1 (M1-instrument, 'how the shared knowing is held') is flagged genuinely-thin — the ancients answer it only obliquely; the modern epistemological form of the question has no strong single answerer in the bank.

nodes.label: M5->M6: firstborn -> historical call
nodes.why_selected: under-commented; the M5->M6 edge is load-bearing — it seams eternal family-status to historical call.
nodes.question: Why does the Son's being FIRSTBORN (eternal family-status) entail a historical CALLING of the siblings? The jump from primogeniture to a temporal call is not spelled out.

nodes.label: M4 interior: what conformity FEELS like
nodes.why_selected: novelty; the felt texture of being-conformed was noticed only by participatory/practice frames the doctrinal majority skipped.
nodes.question: What does conformity-to-the-Son's-image feel like FROM INSIDE? The interior experience of being-conformed (M4 'predestined to be conformed') is unsaid.

nodes.label: M5 reciprocity: do the siblings answer back?
nodes.why_selected: under-commented; sibling reciprocity is load-bearing for relational ontology but missed by critics fixed on the decree-chain's downward direction.
nodes.question: Whether the many brethren ACKNOWLEDGE / relate back to the firstborn is unsaid. Is the family relation one-directional (decreed downward) or genuinely reciprocal?

nodes.label: M7 instrument: BY WHAT MEANS justified?
nodes.question: By what MEANS is justification effected (faith? Christ's work? infused grace?) — not stated in the chain. THE Reformation gap.

nodes.label: M1 warrant: on whose authority 'we know'?
nodes.question: On whose authority does 'we know' rest — the ground of the assurance is unnamed. The assurance-basis gap.

nodes.label: M2->M3 edge: leap to election
nodes.question: Why does the guarantee (all-things-work-for-good for lovers-of-God) rest on a prior divine FOREKNOWING of a set? The leap from providential synergy to election is unstated.

nodes.label: M8 interior: what glory FEELS like inside
nodes.question: What the glorified-ones experience inwardly of glory is unsaid. The interior of the chain's terminus.

nodes.label: M8 warrant: how is 'glorified' (aorist) already secured?
nodes.question: On what authority is the aorist 'he also glorified' — past tense for a still-future thing — taken as ALREADY secured? The assurance/perseverance gap at the chain's end.

nodes.label: M6 instrument: by what means does the call reach?
nodes.question: By what means does the calling reach its addressees — preaching? the Spirit? both? — is unnamed.

nodes.label: M7 interior: what being-justified FEELS like
nodes.question: The justified-ones' inner experience of being declared right is unsaid.

nodes.label: M8 instrument: by what means is glorification accomplished?
nodes.question: By what means is glorification accomplished — resurrection? vision? deification? — not stated.

nodes.label: M3 substrate: WHO are 'those'?
nodes.question: Grammar-slot UNDERDETERMINED: 'those' — a set of persons, not yet further characterized. Who are they, and by what is the set defined? The keystone of the whole election controversy.

nodes.label: M4 instrument: by what means is the conforming done?
nodes.question: By what means is the conforming-to-the-image accomplished — Spirit? suffering? sacraments? — is unnamed.

nodes.label: M6 interior: what being-called FEELS like
nodes.question: What being-called is experienced as — audible? inward? sudden? gradual? — is unsaid.

nodes.label: M8 degree: how FULL is glory?
nodes.question: The extent / fullness of glory is unspecified. Is it total, or graded — and can a creature receive it fully?

nodes.label: M1 instrument: how is the shared knowing held?
nodes.question: By what means is the shared knowing ('we know...') held or transmitted — tradition? the Spirit's witness? experience? — is unsaid. Flagged genuinely-thin: the ancients answer this only obliquely.

nodes.label: M5 reason: why FIRSTBORN, not simply elder?
nodes.question: Why must the Son be FIRSTBORN (prototokos) rather than simply elder or unique? The primogeniture logic — rank, headship, inheritance-to-share — is unspoken.

nodes.label: M2 degree: how comprehensively do 'all things' co-work?
nodes.question: How comprehensively do 'all things' co-work for good — literally all, including evils and sins? No calibration of scope/intensity is given.

nodes.label: Augustine
nodes.work: Ad Simplicianum; De praedestinatione sanctorum; De dono perseverantiae; De civitate Dei 22; Confessiones; Enchiridion
nodes.position: Foreknowledge = gratuitous election, not foreseen merit; even the will's turning is prevenient gift; perseverance is itself a donum; all things (etiam peccata) are ordered to the good of the elect; glory = the beatific vision, the eternal Sabbath.

nodes.label: Luther
nodes.work: Lectures on Romans; Commentary on Galatians; 95 Theses
nodes.position: The chain read through sola fide: alien righteousness laid hold of by faith alone; the viva vox evangelii (the preached Word) creating the brethren it names; the terrified conscience finding peace in Christ.

nodes.label: Calvin
nodes.work: Commentary on Romans; Institutes I.16-18 (providence), III.21-24 (election/calling/perseverance)
nodes.position: Eternal unconditional election is the fountainhead; the external call by the Word + the internal effectual call by the Spirit; meticulous providence governs every event; assurance rests on the immutable decree; the testimonium Spiritus internum grounds the knowing.

nodes.label: Arminius
nodes.work: Examination of Perkins; Declaration of Sentiments
nodes.position: Foreknowledge = prescience of foreseen faith; calling is resistible; the 'those' are foreseen believers as a class defined by faith, not a fixed roster.

nodes.label: Athanasius
nodes.work: Orations against the Arians; De Incarnatione
nodes.position: Firstborn (prototokos) = the Word made flesh, not a creature, so that many share His sonship; conformity + glory = theosis, incorruption regained, 'God became man that man might become god.'

nodes.label: Anselm
nodes.position: Reads the chain through convenientia/satisfactio: God will not leave incomplete what He began in rational nature; the free-yet-fitting movement of the will toward the summum bonum.

nodes.label: Aquinas
nodes.work: Super Epistolam ad Romanos (c.8 lect.6); ST I q.22-23, I-II q.113, Suppl. (lumen gloriae)
nodes.position: Predestination as the ratio in the divine mind ordering the elect to grace + glory; real secondary causes (call, sacraments as instrumental causes of grace, infused virtue); providence extends to all particulars; glory = the lumen gloriae, graded by capacity/charity though the vision never comprehends God.

nodes.label: Karl Barth
nodes.position: Christ is both electing God and elect human; election is God's Yes in Christ, not a fixed roster of individuals; the 'those' is Christ and all in Him.

nodes.label: Origen
nodes.position: Foreknowledge is God's prescience of each soul's free response — the fountainhead of the foreseen-faith reading.

nodes.label: John Chrysostom
nodes.position: Reads foreknowledge non-deterministically: calling honours human willingness; predestination follows foreseen assent; the call goes out to all.

nodes.label: Pelagius
nodes.position: Foreknowledge attaches to those God foresaw would believe by free will; the chain rewards foreseen faith; reciprocity is real and unaided.

nodes.label: John Wesley
nodes.work: Explanatory Notes upon the NT (Rom 8); Sermons on Several Occasions (SRC-250961) — 'The Witness of the Spirit', 'The Scripture Way of Salvation', 'Christian Perfection'
nodes.position: Prevenient grace enables all to respond; assurance = the witness of the Spirit felt NOW (Rom 8:16), present and forfeitable, not decree-grounded; conformity aims at perfect love / entire sanctification; justification by faith alone (Aldersgate: 'my heart strangely warmed'); grace is resistible. In the Christian reading bank (SRC-250961) but NOT on the cc20_rom8_s156 panel — all edges inferred.

nodes.label: C. E. B. Cranfield
nodes.work: A Critical and Exegetical Commentary on Romans (ICC, vol. 1), Rom 8:28-30
nodes.position: Grammatical-historical: prototokos denotes rank/headship of the new humanity + resurrection priority (firstborn of the dead); 'those' = the called as God's elect community; the aorists express the certainty of God's purpose. §3 in-copyright — name-persona / proxy only; edges inferred and flagged for careful sourcing.

edges.fill: The eternal decree of family-status must issue in a temporal vocatio by which the predestined are gathered, else primogeniture would be sterile.
edges.note: gloss-seated; via vocatio congrua — the passage from aeterna praedestinatio to its historical execution.

edges.fill: Because the eternal election by which God appointed Christ the Firstborn of a chosen family is executed in time through the effectual Calling — the Spirit's secret operation by which the elect are drawn out of the corrupt mass and united to the Head whose penal satisfaction has already been reckoned to them — the primogeniture of Christ necessarily entails a historical vocatio, since the decree touches its objects only through the ordained means of Word and Spirit.
edges.note: gloss-seated (cc20_rom8_grounding_s156); The gap asks why the eternal fraternity of the Firstborn must break into history as a call spoken to particular men in time. From this seat the answer is fixed: election is confirmed by Calling (III.2

edges.fill: Primogeniture is a naked fiction unless the historical call goes out; the call is the Word, and the Word creates the brethren it names.
edges.note: gloss-seated; the viva vox evangelii summoning sinners out of despair.

edges.fill: Because the God-man alone could render the satisfactio which the honor of God required, and because that satisfaction was paid in time on the Cross, the fraternity of the Firstborn cannot remain a bare eternal fittingness but must be applied in history through an actual vocatio by which each brother is joined to the merit already offered — else God would have begun in human nature a work He did not perfect, which is unfitting (indecens).
edges.note: gloss-seated (cc20_rom8_grounding_s156); The gap asks why the eternal primogeniture of the Son must issue in a temporal call to His brethren. From this seat the answer follows by necessitas non cogens: it is fitting that what God incepit in

edges.fill: Because God's foreknowledge sees who, being drawn by prevenient grace, will not resist the Gospel and so be conformed to the image of His Son, the primogeniture of Christ necessarily unfolds as a historical vocatio in which the Firstborn's brethren are actually called, and their conformity is realized only as each freely responds in faith to that temporal summons.
edges.note: gloss-seated (cc20_rom8_grounding_s156); The gap asks why the eternal fraternity of the Firstborn must issue in a call spoken within time. From this seat the answer is that election is not absolute but conditional: God predestines to sonship

edges.fill: Because the Word became man that men might be made sons, the primogeniture of the Firstborn among many brethren is not a static rank but the very reason for His bodily Appearing in time — the same Word who fashioned us in the beginning must, in history, call His brethren by voice and by flesh, drawing kindred nature into kindred nature so that what He is by nature they may become by grace.

edges.fill: From within, conformity to the Son's image feels as the whole life become repentance — a daily hatred of self clinging by naked faith to Christ crucified, in which the terror of the Law and the sweet assurance of the Gospel are held together as simul iustus et peccator.

edges.fill: From within, conformity to the Son's image feels as mortification and vivification wrought by the secret operation of the Spirit — the bearing of the cross in self-denial joined to the sure and settled peace of a conscience that, contemplating the judgment-seat, rests wholly on Christ's imputed righteousness.
edges.note: gloss-seated (cc20_rom8_grounding_s156); My frame asks: what could the interior of this conformity be, when man is by nature miserably enslaved and every thing proceeding from his corrupt nature is damnable, save that which the Spirit works?

edges.fill: From within, conformity to the Son's image feels as the freely consenting yes of a will awakened by prevenient grace — a growing love that willingly takes up Christ's obedience, tempered by the sober awareness that this yes must be daily renewed lest one fall away.
edges.note: gloss-seated (cc20_rom8_grounding_s156); My frame asks: what could the interior be, if not the felt cooperation of a soul now enabled and drawn, in which the Spirit's work and the believer's answering assent are inwardly one act? It cannot b

edges.fill: From within, conformity to the Son's image feels as the incorruption of the Word taking root in our very flesh — mortality being unmade by His life, the image of the Father shining again in a nature won back from death, so that we begin to know from within what it is to be deified in Him.

edges.fill: From within, conformity to the Son's image feels as the ordered rectitude of the rational will restored — the creature at last loving the summum bonum for its own sake and beginning to enjoy God (frui Deo) as the very beatitude for which it was made, the debt paid by the Deus-Homo now bearing its proper fruit in a will made upright.
edges.note: gloss-seated (cc20_rom8_grounding_s156); My frame asks: what could the interior of this conformity be, if not the rectitudo voluntatis for which the rational nature was fashioned — that the creature, freed by the God-Man's satisfaction from

edges.fill: Whether the *fratres* acknowledge and relate back to the Primogenitus is not left to their unaided will but is itself the work of prevenient grace: those whom God foreknew and predestined He also called *effectively*, and their answering recognition of the Firstborn is the very sign that the call has taken.
edges.note: gloss-seated (cc20_rom8_grounding_s156); From my frame the question of reciprocity cannot be posed as if it hung on the brethren's initiative — *quid habes quod non accepisti?* If the siblings turn and confess the Firstborn, it is because gr

edges.fill: The brethren do relate back to the Firstborn, but only because the Spirit secretly applies to them the benefits Christ has already procured — their acknowledgment is the effect of election calling them, not a condition upon which their conformity to the Firstborn depends.
edges.note: gloss-seated (cc20_rom8_grounding_s156); My frame will not allow reciprocity to become a hinge on which the golden chain turns; the chain runs from foreknowledge through predestination to glorification, and the siblings' relating-back is a f

edges.fill: The brethren's relating-back to the Firstborn is nothing other than *faith* — the empty-handed clinging that receives Him as gift — and it is unsaid here because Paul is naming the Father's work in the chain, not the sinner's contribution: the reciprocity is real, but it is itself faith wrought in us, not a merit rendered back.
edges.note: gloss-seated (cc20_rom8_grounding_s156); My frame refuses to let reciprocity be smuggled in as a work the siblings owe to secure their place. The question I press is: does the text leave a slot the indulgence-sellers could fill with satisfac

edges.fill: It is *conveniens* that the brethren, receiving from the Primogenitus the inheritance His satisfaction alone could win, render back to Him the *honor* proper to a firstborn — for a satisfaction that redounds to co-heirs who withhold recognition would leave the household still disordered, and God's *inceptum* imperfectly perfected.
edges.note: gloss-seated (cc20_rom8_grounding_s156); My frame reasons from fittingness: the satisfaction Christ pays restores the honor due to God, and the brethren's answering acknowledgment of the Firstborn is the very way that restored honor is reali

edges.fill: The brethren's acknowledgment of the Firstborn is the very hinge on which their being *conformed to His image* actually turns: by grace prevenient they are enabled, and by faith freely-responsive they consent, to relate back to Him — a reciprocity real on both sides, not a monergistic pageant staged from one.

edges.fill: The brethren's relating-back to the Firstborn is the very substance of *deification*: as they are conformed to His image they come to know Him as the Elder Brother who has already conquered death on their behalf, and their acknowledgment is the answering-love of a nature being remade in His likeness — not a legal reply, but the creature's turning toward the Word by whom it is being renewed.
edges.note: gloss-seated (cc20_rom8_grounding_s156); My frame reads the silence as fitting, because reciprocity here is not a transaction added to salvation but the *shape* salvation takes in the brethren: to be conformed to the image is to relate-back,

edges.fill: Predestination is the ratio in the divine mind ordering the elect to grace and glory; the temporal call is the real secondary cause through which that eternal ordering is executed.
edges.note: inferred from Super Rom c.8 lect.6 + ST I q.23; not filed on this gap in the run.

edges.fill: The call goes out to all and honours human willingness; primogeniture entails a call precisely because the family is gathered by foreseen assent, not decree.
edges.note: inferred from Homilies on Romans (Hom. 15); not filed on this gap in the run.

edges.fill: There is no jump to reconcile: the call is God's universal Yes in Christ the elect human; primogeniture and vocation are one Christological act, not two temporal stages.
edges.note: inferred from CD II/2; not filed on this gap in the run.

edges.fill: The siblings' acknowledgment is a genuine act of the created will AND wholly caused by God as first cause — real secondary causality means the response is truly theirs and truly grace.
edges.note: inferred from the concursus doctrine (ST I q.23); harmonises with Augustine while granting real reciprocity.

edges.fill: The acknowledgment is the soul's own free response, which God merely foreknew; the family is reciprocal because the siblings genuinely turn back of themselves.
edges.note: inferred from Comm. in Romanos bk 7 — the foreseen-faith fountainhead.

edges.fill: The brethren acknowledge the firstborn by their own free will; the reciprocity is entirely real and unaided — the answering love is the sibling's native act.
edges.note: inferred from Expositio in Romanos — the free-will reading Augustine forms his election doctrine against; the polar opposite of Augustine's grounded edge on this gap.

edges.fill: The 'those' is not a roster whose reciprocity must be secured; in Christ the elect human, the answering-back is already given in Him and need not be an anxious human contribution.
edges.note: inferred from CD II/2; dissolves the roster question the whole panel argues over.

edges.fill: Justification is effected by the sole work of Christ crucified, laid hold of by faith alone — a faith which is itself no work of ours but the empty hand that receives, so that the whole life of the believer is the poenitentiam agite of trusting Him and nothing else.
edges.note: gloss-seated (cc20_rom8_grounding_s156); From this stance the gap is the very hinge on which everything turns: the moment the instrument is left unnamed, the trade in indulgences and satisfactions rushes in to fill it, as if the sinner contr

edges.fill: Justification is effected by the meritorious work of Christ the Mediator — who in our stead bore the curse of the Law and satisfied the Father's judgment — and is made available to us by the secret operation of the Spirit through the sole instrument of faith, which apprehends and applies that righteousness without adding anything of its own.
edges.note: gloss-seated (cc20_rom8_grounding_s156); From this stance the gap must be filled on two registers at once, for confusing them is the fountain of every sophistical error: the meritorious cause is Christ's substitutionary satisfaction, and the

edges.fill: By grace INFUSED into the soul (gratia gratum faciens) that makes the sinner actually righteous — justification as a real transformation, not only a forensic declaration.
edges.note: inferred from ST I-II q.113; the Catholic infused-grace answer against which the Reformation gap is drawn.

edges.fill: Justification is effected by the meritorious sacrifice of Christ alone, received through faith alone — a faith itself kindled by that prevenient grace which awakens even the sleeping conscience, and inwardly witnessed to the believer by the Spirit's own testimony that he is a child of God.

edges.fill: The 'set' foreknown is the class of foreseen believers, not an absolute decree; the guarantee rests on God's foreknowledge of faith, so the leap is to prescience, not election.
edges.note: inferred; consistent with Arminius's grounded reframes but not filed on this specific edge-gap in the run.

edges.fill: There is no unwarranted leap: providence for the lovers-of-God is only the visible face of election; the guarantee rests on foreknowing precisely because foreknowing IS God's electing love from eternity.
edges.note: inferred from Institutes III.21-24; makes the edge a seam within one decree rather than a jump between two orders.

edges.fill: The guarantee rests on foreknowing only as prescience — God, foreseeing who would love Him, ordered all things to their good; the leap is to honour foreseen willingness, not to impose a decree.
edges.note: inferred from Homilies on Romans (Hom. 15); the non-deterministic reading of the same edge.

edges.fill: The foreknowing is not the selection of a set but God's eternal self-determination to be for humanity in Christ; the guarantee rests on that Yes, so the 'leap' dissolves into one act of grace.
edges.note: inferred from CD II/2; dissolves rather than bridges the edge.

edges.fill: What the glorified inwardly experience is the quiet cessation of that concupiscentia which the law had exposed but could not conquer — a delight now made sweet by grace where before the forbidden was falsely sweet, so that the will at last wills the good it once only knew as commanded.

edges.fill: The warrant for the past-tense as already-secured is the direct inward witness of the Holy Spirit — testifying with the believer's own spirit, upon the finished work of Christ, that he is even now a child of God — grounded in the Oracles of God and preserved by that same prevenient grace which awakened him from the sleep of death.
edges.note: gloss-seated (cc20_rom8_grounding_s156); From my frame the assurance-basis must be plainly named, for a soul left to reason its way to a past-tense standing will oscillate between presumption and the very Pena damni I have described. The Spi

edges.fill: The aorist is secured because glorification is already accomplished in Christ the elect human; it is spoken in the past tense because in Him it is a finished fact, not a probability awaiting individuals.
edges.note: inferred from CD II/2; the Christological ground for the past tense.

edges.fill: The calling reaches its addressees by the outward preaching of the Word joined to the secret and efficacious operation of the Holy Spirit, who alone makes the external summons pierce the elect heart and confirms election by an effectual call.
edges.note: gloss-seated (cc20_rom8_grounding_s156); Scripture sets forth a double calling: a general summons uttered through the preached gospel, which the reprobate hear and despise, and a special, inward vocation by which the Spirit seals the promise

edges.fill: The calling reaches its addressees by the preached Word of the gospel — Christ's own promise of free grace — which the Holy Spirit drives home into the terrified conscience so that faith is kindled where before there was only despair.
edges.note: gloss-seated (cc20_rom8_grounding_s156); If the instrument of the call is left unnamed, the tetzels of every age will fill the silence with their bells and their letters, telling souls the summons comes by coins, canons, or the pope's keys.

edges.fill: The calling reaches its addressees by the preached Word offered to every soul and by the prevenient grace of the Holy Spirit, who awakens the conscience, draws freely, and waits upon the sinner's response.
edges.note: gloss-seated (cc20_rom8_grounding_s156); The Oracles of God reveal a summons that is universal and serious: God's warnings and invitations are extended to every one that will hear, and no soul is left without some measure of light. My frame

edges.fill: What the justified inwardly experience is the sudden turn from almost-despair to the assurance of safety — the conscience that had trembled under its own hatred-of-self hearing God's own declaration that the guilt is remitted, and clinging by faith alone to that word rather than to any keys, canon, or penalty of its own paying.
edges.note: gloss-seated (cc20_rom8_grounding_s156); From my stance, the interior of justification must be read against the interior of the trembling penitent whose whole life is repentance: heaven and purgatory differ as assurance and almost-despair, a

edges.fill: What the justified inwardly experience is the Spirit's witness with their spirit that they are the children of God — the awakened soul, once trembling under the fear of him who has power to cast into hell, now feeling the pardoning love of the Father shed abroad in the heart, and knowing by that inward testimony that its sins are forgiven.
edges.note: gloss-seated (cc20_rom8_grounding_s156); From my stance, the interior of justification must be read as the answer to the awakening: prevenient grace stirred the sleeper, convincing grace showed the wrath to flee, and now the pardoning word t

edges.fill: What the justified inwardly experience is the shift from fallax dulcedo to vera dulcedo — the reatus that the law had wakened now lifted by grace, so that the soul first tastes as sweet what it had only known as commanded, and knows itself no longer under the sentence of death but subdued to God in pia humilitas.
edges.note: gloss-seated (cc20_rom8_grounding_s156); From my stance, the interior of justification must be read against the interior of the man sub lege: there the mandate revealed sin and killed by the accession of guilt, and the will, unable to resist

edges.fill: Glorification is accomplished by the lumen gloriae — a created light infused into the intellect that elevates it to see the divine essence; the beatific vision the natural intellect could never reach unaided.
edges.note: inferred from ST I q.12 + Suppl.; the precise scholastic instrument of glory. NOT on the run panel.

edges.fill: Glorification is accomplished by the incarnate Word Himself, who having assumed our nature, trampled death by His cross and resurrection, and now, dwelling in us by His Spirit, communicates His own incorruption to our flesh — the same Agent by whom all things were made being the very instrument by whom they are brought to their divine end.
edges.note: gloss-seated (cc20_rom8_grounding_s156); The Apostle names no separate means because none other is fitting: as the renewal of creation is wrought by the Self-same Word who made it, so the glorification of the called is nothing else than the

edges.fill: Glorification is accomplished by the same sovereign hand that elected, called, and justified — namely, by the merit of Christ our Mediator, whose penal death and resurrection have purchased the whole of salvation, applied to the elect by the secret operation of the Holy Spirit and consummated at the last resurrection according to the eternal decree.
edges.note: gloss-seated (cc20_rom8_grounding_s156); The Apostle names no separate instrument because none may be interposed: the golden chain is unbroken precisely because one and the same God, having chosen His own in Christ before the world was, carr

edges.fill: Illi sunt non quilibet ex massa peccatrice indifferenter sumpti, sed hi quos Deus ante constitutionem mundi secundum propositum suum praescivit et praedestinavit, quos et pia humilitate suae gratiae subicit ut lex per eandem gratiam in eis impleri possit.
edges.note: gloss-seated (cc20_rom8_grounding_s156); From this stance the substrate cannot be left as an unrestricted 'set of persons,' for the whole Apostle's argument — which I have just expounded — is that no man rises out of the massa peccatrix by h

edges.fill: Those whom God, by His prescient regard of their Spirit-enabled faith in Christ, foreknew as believers, and whom on that condition He predestines, calls, justifies, and glorifies.
edges.note: gloss-seated (cc20_rom8_grounding_s156); My frame asks: does the openness of 'those' not itself refuse the absolute decree, since Paul immediately grounds the chain in a foreknowing that must have some object to know? The substrate cannot be

edges.fill: 'Those' are those chosen in Christ before the foundation of the world; the substrate is filled by eternal election, and every later link (call, justify, glorify) is only its unfolding.
edges.note: inferred from Institutes III.21; the elect-roster reading.

edges.fill: 'Those' is not a set of individuals at all — it is Christ the elect human and, in Him, all humanity; the underdetermined slot is filled Christologically, dissolving the roster question.
edges.note: inferred from CD II/2; the modern dissolution of the substrate. THIS gap is the keystone — every camp answers it and none closes it (see 'refuses-to-close' finding).

edges.fill: The conforming is accomplished by grace infused through instrumental causes — the sacraments as channels of grace, the infused theological virtues, and the gifts of the Spirit reshaping the soul to the Son's likeness.
edges.note: inferred from ST III (sacraments as instrumental causes) + I-II q.62; directly answers the 'sacraments?' branch of the gap. NOT on the run panel.

edges.fill: The conforming is accomplished by the *secret operation of the Holy Spirit*, who applies to the elect the benefits Christ has already procured in bearing their penalty — sufferings, sacraments, and the whole discipline of the Christian life serving as external helps by which the Spirit conducts this inward work, never as instruments meritoriously effecting it.
edges.note: gloss-seated (cc20_rom8_grounding_s156); My frame will not let the instrument-slot become a place where human works are inserted alongside Christ's finished satisfaction. The question I press on the silence is: whose agency conforms the bret

edges.fill: The conforming is accomplished by the Holy Spirit working through *all the means of grace* — Word, prayer, sacraments, holy fellowship, and the sanctifying use of sufferings — met by the awakened soul's responsive faith, that assurance and holiness may grow together into the image of the Firstborn.
edges.note: gloss-seated (cc20_rom8_grounding_s156); My frame refuses to name a single instrument, for the Spirit uses many, and to omit any is to shrink the way God actually conforms His children. The question I press on the silence is: by what appoint

edges.fill: Being-called is experienced, in those whom God has effectually called, as an inward drawing (congrua vocatio) by which the mind is so moved that what was once bitter under the letter of the law becomes sweet under grace — not primarily as an audible summons nor as a merely gradual persuasion, but as the secret operation by which the will itself is made to consent.
edges.note: gloss-seated (cc20_rom8_grounding_s156); From where I stand, having wrestled with Simplicianus that the very consent by which a man is called is itself a gift, I must not name the interior of the call as though it were the natural motion of

edges.fill: Being-called is experienced first as the still, small strivings of prevenient grace awakening the sinner to a sense of his lostness, then as the direct witness of the Spirit bearing witness with our spirit that we are the children of God — an inward, felt persuasion, ordinarily gradual in its dawning but often sudden in its full assurance, and confirmed by the abiding fruit of love, peace, and holiness of life.
edges.note: gloss-seated (cc20_rom8_grounding_s156); From where I stand, the interior of the call must never be left blank, or the awakened soul will not know whether to trust the whisper it hears; and yet it must not be reduced to any one register, for

edges.fill: Glory is full for each but GRADED — all the blessed see the divine essence, yet each sees more or less clearly in proportion to charity; the vision never comprehends God, so fullness is real but never exhausts its object.
edges.note: inferred from ST I q.12 a.6; Aquinas explicitly calibrates the degree the text leaves open — but even his answer reserves an eschatological remainder (see partial-close note). NOT on the run panel.

edges.fill: The extent of the glory is nothing less than the full deification of the brethren — the whole human nature they bear made incorruptible and taken up into the very likeness of the Firstborn, so that what the Word is by nature they become by grace, sharing His victory over death without measure or remainder.
edges.note: gloss-seated (cc20_rom8_grounding_s156); The gap is left open because the fullness cannot be reckoned by any creaturely scale; the measure is the Word Himself, who did not become man by halves and does not divinize by halves. My frame asks —

edges.fill: The shared knowing is held by the inward testimony of the Holy Spirit sealing the truth of Scripture upon the hearts of the elect — not by the judgment of the Church, nor by private revelation, nor by unaided experience, but by the Spirit conjoined to the written Word.
edges.note: gloss-seated (cc20_rom8_grounding_s156); My frame asks: by what warrant do we say 'we know,' when the human mind, though naturally imbued with a sense of deity, corrupts and stifles that knowledge at every turn? It cannot be tradition, for t

edges.fill: The knowing is held by faith — an infused habit assenting to first Truth on God's own authority, handed on through the Church's teaching; not private experience but a supernatural virtue.
edges.note: inferred from ST II-II q.1-2; the infused-faith account. GAP FLAGGED THIN.

edges.fill: The shared knowing is held by the direct witness of the Holy Spirit — the Spirit bearing witness with our spirit that we are the children of God — confirmed by the Scriptures and by the fruits of grace in a heart and life renewed.
edges.note: gloss-seated (cc20_rom8_grounding_s156); My frame asks: by what means may a plain believer truly say 'we know,' and not merely hope or suppose? It must be the Spirit's own testimony, freely offered to every soul awakened by prevenient grace

edges.fill: The Son must be firstborn (prōtotokos), not merely 'only' or 'elder,' because primogeniture names the office by which the Word — Himself uniquely eternally begotten as Only-Begotten — becomes, in the flesh He has assumed, head of a many whom He gathers into His own incorruption by real kinship.
edges.note: gloss-seated (cc20_rom8_grounding_s156); The Word is Only-Begotten of the Father in His divinity; but in becoming man He is called Firstborn among many brethren, and the change of title is not idle. My frame asks: why does the Apostle place

edges.fill: 'Firstborn' signifies preeminence and headship — Christ as caput of the mystical body who holds the inheritance and communicates it to the brethren; the firstborn is the principle of the family's grace.
edges.note: inferred from Super Rom c.8 + ST III q.8; Christ as Head.

edges.fill: Grammatically, prototokos here carries both temporal priority (firstborn from the dead in resurrection) and rank/dignity (the honoured Head of the eschatological family), not mere seniority.
edges.note: inferred from ICC Romans on 8:29. §3 IN-COPYRIGHT — name-persona/proxy only; flagged for careful sourcing, do not quote as attested.

edges.fill: The 'all things' that co-work for good extend without exception to every event befalling the predestined — prosperities and adversities, temptations and consolations, even their very sins and the lex which multiplies transgression — since God, whose secret providence orders the whole massa, so bends each thing to the profit of those He has called secundum propositum that nothing whatever falls outside the scope, and nothing works with less intensity than He wills for their conformity to the Filius.
edges.note: gloss-seated (cc20_rom8_grounding_s156); The gap is left open because omnia truly means omnia, and the intensity is measured by the propositum vocantis, not by any weight the sibling could reckon; even the law given ut demonstraretur peccatu

edges.fill: The 'all things' that co-work for good extend to every event without exception — prosperities and adversities, the sins of the wicked and the failings of the elect themselves, the instrumentality of Satan no less than the ministry of angels — for the same secret Providence that governs each and every part of creation bends every one of them, at whatever intensity He appoints, to the salvation which the penal satisfaction of Christ has already secured for those whom the Father gave Him.
edges.note: gloss-seated (cc20_rom8_grounding_s156); The gap is left open because omnia is not to be calibrated by any human scale; to name a scope less than universal would deny the Providence that governs each and all its parts, and to specify an inte

edges.fill: Divine providence extends to all particulars; God permits even evils in order to draw from them a greater good, so 'all things' co-work by the ordering of the First Cause who governs all.
edges.note: inferred from ST I q.22; the scope calibrated by universal providence.
